description: Six channels mixed in two groups of three, each group with its own output and a voltage controlled path for every channel

params.text: Sets the level of channels one to three at their own output, and the level of all six channels at the SUM output of that group
Sets the level of channels four to six at their own output, and the level of all six channels at the SUM output of that group
Sets the level of that channel
Sets the level of the fifth channel, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Ch 6
Sets the level of the sixth channel, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Ch 5
Sets how much of the group's mix its MOD IN jack passes

inputs.text: Opens a voltage controlled path carrying the mix of the group that channel belongs to: 0-10V passes it at the level of the mod slider, and it is added to every output

outputs.text: All six channels mixed at the level set for channels four to six, with all six mod paths added
All six channels mixed at the level set for channels one to three, with all six mod paths added
Channels four to six mixed, with the mod paths of those three channels added
Channels one to three mixed, with the mod paths of those three channels added
